Plan: compare Sentinel-2 L2A (10 m, 5-day revisit) and GLAD Landsat ARD (30 m, long archive); recommend Sentinel-2 for recent monitoring with Landsat for history. Steps: cloud-mask with SCL, build quarterly medians, compute forest-loss indicators. Limitations: persistent tropical cloud cover; license and egress costs vary.
